title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 40: City life (Set 1)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm City life (Set 1) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

lessons.title: học từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng thuộc bài City life (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Read the following announcement and choose the option that best fits each blank. Warning: Air Pollution in the City Attention all residents! The air quality in the city has worsened recently. Here’s what you need to know: 🚗 There are too many cars in the city, so the atmosphere is in a(n) 15.1 green fresh unsafe miserable  condition. 🌫️ The 15.2 light water air soil pollution levels have increased so it is difficult to breathe in some areas. 🏗️ Some construction 15.3 materials costs workers sites are noisy, so it may cause noise pollution. 😷 The pollution can cause problems like a 15.4 clear hot sore frozen throat or itchy eyes if you're exposed for too long. To avoid and reduce the effects of pollution on your health, you should: Stay indoors when pollution levels are high. Wear a mask to protect your lungs and nose. Avoid busy streets and construction zones. Use public transportation like the 15.5 plane truck rocket metro , or bus. Please take precautions and stay safe!

In the future, 14.1 will be more modern and eco-friendly. 14.2 will have lots of 14.3 , like parks and gardens, where people can relax and enjoy fresh air. Many of these cities will be 14.4 , located near the sea, offering beautiful views and a peaceful environment. 14.5 , such as libraries, sports centers, and playgrounds, will be easy to access and well-maintained. 14.6 will also improve, with hospitals and clinics using advanced technology to keep everyone healthy. Life in these cities will be healthier, greener, and more enjoyable for everyone.

vocabTable.example: Reorder the letters to make complete words. The first letters are underlined. Phong: I feel 13.1 (R-E-R-B-I-L- T -E) today. Phong: You’re right. The air in the city is so bad these days. I get itchy 13.4 (Y-S- E -E) too. Mai: It’s hard to breathe, and the pollution makes everything worse. Maybe we should plan a weekend trip to the countryside to get some fresh air. Phong: That sounds great! I definitely need a break from all the dust.
